checks.name: manifest URL uniqueness and required evidence fields
summary matches actual manifest and upload counts
every English 200 has a declared pair or explicit missing-pair flag
every observed retired-language URL has a proposed English 200 destination
redirect proposals unique and never self-redirect
distinct FAQ pages preserved in inventory
all classified in-scope EN/ES pages have both screenshot references
document paths preserve wp-content/uploads and uncertain references are labeled
required report/logs and inventory artifacts present
all local screenshot images have valid signatures and dimensions
raw exports and screenshot binaries ignored and untracked

warnings.coverage: conditional; missing database/uploads, CSS/document completeness and conditional runtime behavior remain unresolved

meaning: Snapshot consistency passes do not establish live-site parity, complete input coverage, approved redirects, accessibility compliance or launch readiness.
